description: This file contains a collection of graph generation functions for the Apache Spark GraphX library, including methods for creating log-normal, R-MAT, grid, and star graphs, with internal utility functions for sampling and edge creation.

classes.name: GraphGenerators
classes.description: Object containing various graph generating functions, including log-normal, R-MAT, grid, and star graph generators.

methods.name: logNormalGraph
methods.description: Generates a graph with a log-normal out-degree distribution, parameterized by mu, sigma, and seed.

methods.name: generateRandomEdges
methods.description: Creates an array of random edges originating from a source vertex.

methods.name: sampleLogNormal
methods.description: Samples a value from a log-normal distribution with given mu and sigma, bounded by maxVal.

methods.name: rmatGraph
methods.description: Generates a graph based on the R-MAT model, with specified number of vertices and edges.

methods.name: outDegreeFromEdges
methods.description: Constructs a graph from edges, calculating out-degree for each vertex.

methods.name: addEdge
methods.description: Recursively adds an edge based on R-MAT parameters.

methods.name: chooseCell
methods.description: Recursively subdivides the adjacency matrix to select a cell for edge placement.

methods.name: pickQuadrant
methods.description: Selects a quadrant based on R-MAT probabilities.

methods.name: gridGraph
methods.description: Creates a grid graph with specified rows and columns.

methods.name: starGraph
methods.description: Creates a star graph with a central vertex connected to all others.
